slices.focus: The heaviest fall quarter proves Nadia's intake system holds: housing placement targets met, follow-ups maintained.
slices.summary: The most demanding fall quarter Nadia has supervised puts her intake system to a real stress test. Housing placement times stay near target, missed follow-ups do not cascade, and staff use the written manual as a live playbook rather than a shelf document. Cross-trained backup staff are 'useful fast.' Nadia plans to create a one-page evidence summary, draft three supervisor-only intervention categories (exceptions, tradeoffs, escalation), and present results upward as proof the system works rather than an argument for stretched capacity.
open_loops: Create one-page evidence summary of fall quarter results
Draft three supervisor-only intervention categories (exceptions, tradeoffs, escalation)
Share categories with team once language is clean
Present findings upward as system proof, not personal victory
decisions: Nadia's documented intake system proved itself during an unusually heavy fall quarter by keeping housing placement times
